Use case: stylized-concept. Production character sprite sheet for PMA dark fantasy anime tactical game. ONE sheet, exactly 1536x1024, six square cells in a strict edge-to-edge 3-column 2-row grid, no gutters, borders, captions, text or watermark. Each 512x512 cell is a separately composed clear anime shot. Order row1 portrait, passive, first attack; row2 support, ultimate, personal defense.
Strict 2D Japanese TV anime animation drawings: bold clean ink contour, flat color fills, two cel shadow tones, graphic stylized face and eyes, graphic background shapes. No realistic rendering, painterly texture, cinematic photographic effects, 3D, skin gradients or pores. Dark but readable; use different background locations, camera angles, cropping, action silhouettes within the same character. Legible at 75px. Preserve face, age, body shape, clothing and signature props in every shot. Natural joints, clear separated limbs, exactly five digits on visible complete hands. Do not draw glowing anatomical mutations. Effects must come from the named character and show their actual ability target. Defensive sixth cell protects ONLY the caster, no shielded group. Setting is Paraíso, a solemn ancient sanctuary world: luminous living stone, pale skies and indigo shadows, no modern technology, no Inferno gore. Characters are original; do not imitate copyrighted characters. Character A que Une, Elo União. Black woman aged60, broad face, wide nose, heavy eyelids, mature stocky build, grey box braids in a low crown. Navy tunic, ivory long sleeveless coat, broad red sash, brass ring-shaped weaving shuttle; power is flat turquoise woven light ribbons with clearly interlocked square weave, not loose thin threads. No duplicates of shuttle.
Cell1: chest-up three-quarter face looking down-left, fingers resting on one shuttle at waist; rainy ivory bridge and dark cypresses.
Cell2 passive healing after support: intimate profile and clavicle/upper chest, her own woven cuff closes a torn sleeve seam with green light; brass shuttle visible waist; stone loom workshop, dawn.
Cell3 Fio de Encontro spiritual hit and drain: enemy shoulder in close foreground, turquoise flat ribbon strikes enemy breastplate and returns one bright stitch toward her red sash; she stands back at right, dynamic diagonal overhead courtyard view, pale blue pools.
Cell4 Reunir os Fragmentos heals/shields/cleanses ONE ally: low side angle seated wounded adult ally forearm foreground, her five-finger hand lays woven turquoise bandage over the forearm, purple smoke leaving and a small woven panel guarding that SAME ally; moonlit white stone infirmary.
Cell5 Fôlego Coletivo team healing/boost: dramatic bird-eye crop her red sash at central fountain, exactly two adult allied silhouettes each connected to ONE flat broad turquoise ribbon and warm gold healing spark; circular terrace among olive trees at sunset.
Cell6 Entrelaçar de Luz invulnerability self: full-body leaning sideways, her OWN coat becomes a close weave of turquoise light as a blade passes without contact beside her shoulder; one woman only, narrow sanctuary stairway over cloudsea at blue night. Avoid same pose and arm-thrust in all cells.
